`remove`: deletes the tenant and everything indexed under them (consents, documents, messages, maintenance requests, privacy requests), their invitation and their login. `erase`: org admin only; opens a deletion privacy request and starts anonymisation (`outcome: erasure_started`). 409 when blocked.

The link is never returned for `email` or `whatsapp`, and never stored in the notification log. A new link replaces the previous one. Audited as `tenant.invite` with the channel.
